items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Was it Jimmy Newell's on? That's Selman, Frank Selman.

ctx.x: Can you remember what kind of clarinet that was? Clarinet, what I'm using now? That one which you were just talking about. Yes, that's the one.
Was it Jimmy Newell's on? That's Selman, Frank Selman.
That's the one you're still using now?
